defs.def: existing or happening now 现存的；当前的

ex.s: The reviews were presented to 400 subjects.
ex.t: 这些评论被呈现给400名受试者。

ex.s: Each subject got eight reviews to read: a balanced set of two positive fake, two positive real, two negative fake and two negative real, presented in a random order.
ex.t: 每位受试者读了八条评论：均衡地包含两条正面虚假、两条正面真实、两条负面虚假和两条负面真实，以随机顺序呈现。

ex.s: How does the author present the issue in the first paragraph?
ex.t: 作者在第一段是如何呈现这一问题的？

ex.s: It presents recreational activities.
ex.t: 它提供娱乐活动。

ex.s: One of them is about how the most accessible information in the present affects decisions about the future.
ex.t: 其中一个是关于：当下最容易获取的信息如何影响对未来的决定。

ex.s: D Bias towards the present helps reduce near-term desires.
ex.t: D 对当前的偏见有助于减少近期的欲望。

ex.s: It presents live entertainment, including pop, rock, folk, jazz, musicals, dance, world music, films and classical music.
ex.t: 它呈现现场娱乐表演，包括流行、摇滚、民谣、爵士、音乐剧、舞蹈、世界音乐、电影和古典音乐。

ex.s: Presenting the best of the West End along with the pick of the UK’s touring shows, the New Theatre is Cardiff’s oldest surviving traditional theatre.
ex.t: 呈现西区最佳剧目以及英国巡演精选，New Theatre是卡迪夫现存最古老的传统剧院。

ex.s: In a recent experiment, cockatoos were presented with a box with a nut inside it.
ex.t: 在最近一项实验中，凤头鹦鹉面对一个里面装着坚果的盒子。

ex.s: To present a fact.
ex.t: 为了陈述一个事实。

ex.s: But with reading, it’s all about the present.
ex.t: 但阅读这件事，全都关乎当下。

ex.s: the present state of our nation
ex.t: 我们国家的现状

ex.s: To present the findings of old science.
ex.t: 展示旧科学的发现。

ex.s: To better know the present and future．
ex.t: 上午10:00 - 下午6:00 竞赛和评委评审

ex.s: Using them without a trainer present is forbidden．
ex.t: D．无训练员在场时使用是被禁止的。

defs.def: being in a particular place 人

ex.s: 63  (choose), but when he presented his masterpiece to the emperor’s chief minister, the old nan laughed.
ex.t: 63  （选择），但当他把他的杰作呈给皇帝的首席大臣时，这位老人笑了。

defs.def: existing in a particular place or thing 事物或物质
a thing that you give to sb as a gift 礼物；礼品

ex.s: This call is open to Burlington-based artists and is open to all art forms that can be presented in a sign format.
ex.t: 本次征集面向Burlington本地艺术家，并接受所有能以标识形式呈现的艺术门类。

ex.s: Sullivan had been thinking about the single present he’d received in 1954 when he was growing up in a small mining town.
ex.t: 沙利文一直想着1954年他在小采矿镇长大时收到的那件唯一的礼物。

ex.s: He then made a small wooden horse, which Sullivan considered the best New Year present ever.
ex.t: 于是他做了一匹小木马，沙利文认为那是史上最好的新年礼物。

ex.s: The beauty of rereading lies in the idea that our bond with the work is based on our present mental register.
ex.t: 是真的，年纪越大，我越觉得时光飞逝。

ex.s: So, we each need to choose a present.
ex.t: 所以，我们每个人都需要选择一份礼物。

ex.s: So we still need to prepare food and drinks I'll make a checklist Preparation choose presents for Grandma draw up the guest list on Wednesday make invitations prepare food and drinks on Sunday morning Who's responsible?
ex.t: 所以我们还需要准备食物和饮料。我来列个清单：准备——给奶奶选礼物；星期三拟好客人名单；做邀请函；准备食物和饮料；星期天早上——谁负责？

ex.s: 36   And it is good time to fill the new space with love and hopefully presents.
ex.t: 36  这正是用爱和 hopefully 礼物来填满新空间的好时机。

ex.s: They made a present for Gordon.
ex.t: 他们给戈登做了一份礼物。

defs.def: the time now 目前；现在

ex.s: Tourism is now the chief industry of Dawson City — its present population is 762.
ex.t: 旅游业如今是道森市的主要产业——其目前人口为762人。

ex.s: At present it is expected to generate £240m for the year ending in April 2019, which will go to school sports.
ex.t: 目前预计到2019年4月截止的财政年度将产生2.4亿英镑的收入，这笔资金将用于学校体育。

ex.s: Fast-forward to the present, an economy has not fully recovered.
ex.t: 快进到现在，经济尚未完全恢复。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

ex.s: The historian Francis Cole argues that the West has entered a period where “only the present exists, a present characterised at once by the cruelty of the instant and by the boredom of an unending now”.
ex.t: 历史学家弗朗西斯·科尔认为，西方已进入一个"只有当下存在"的时期，这个当下同时以瞬间的残酷和无尽现在的无聊为特征。

ex.s: The problems at present are similar to those in the past.
ex.t: 现在的问题与过去的问题相似。

ex.s: Know the Past, Know the Present
ex.t: 了解过去，了解现在

ex.s: At present, these technologies are still expensive, though.
ex.t: 目前，这些技术仍然很昂贵。

ex.s: At present, the world has about 6,800 languages.
ex.t: 目前，世界约有6800种语言。

ex.s: According to the experts, problems faced by people regardless of the past and present are the same.
ex.t: 根据专家的说法，人们无论在过去还是现在所面临的问题都是一样的。

ex.s: How many languages are spoken by less than 6,000 people at present?
ex.t: 目前有多少种语言的使用者少于6000人？

defs.def: to give sth to sb, especially formally at a ceremony 把 … 交给；颁发；授予

ex.s: There almost are no grades, other than‘Are you working towards your goal?’ Basically, it’s ‘I’ve got to produce this product and then, at the end of year, present it to NASA.’ Engineers come and really do an in-person review, and…it’s not a very nice thing at time.
ex.t: 几乎没有任何成绩，除了“你在朝目标努力吗？”基本上就是“我得做出这个产品，然后年底把它展示给NASA。”工程师真的会来做当面评审，而且……这有时并不是件愉快的事。

ex.s: To present a prize.
ex.t: 为了颁发奖项。

defs.def: to show or offer sth for other people to look at or consider 提出；提交

ex.s: present an argument
ex.t: 提出一个论点

ex.s: For the art O-level exam I had to present an oil painting.
ex.t: 为了艺术O-level考试，我必须提交一幅油画。

ex.s: Present past academic records to UCLA.
ex.t: 向加州大学洛杉矶分校提交过去的学业成绩。

ex.s: present a letter from a technical institution
ex.t: 出示一份来自技术院校的证明信

ex.s: present an assumptionB. evaluate an argument
ex.t: 提出一个假设B. 评价一个论点

ex.s: To present a way to break down plastics.
ex.t: 为了提出一种分解塑料的方法。

defs.def: to show or describe sth/sb in a particular way （以某种方式）展现，显示，表现

ex.s: The coming technological advancement presents a chance for cities and states to develop transportation systems designed to move more people, and more affordably.
ex.t: 即将到来的技术进步为城市和各州提供了发展交通系统的机会，这些交通系统旨在以更廉价的方式迁移更多的人。

ex.s: According to the self-discrepancy theory, who presents the most active “ought” self?
ex.t: 根据自我差异理论，谁表现出最活跃的“应该”自我？

ex.s: What might Cathy do for the present company?
ex.t: 男士对自己今天的表现感觉如何？

ex.s: “The music can’t be presented today the way it was in 1908 or 1958.
ex.t: “音乐不能像1908年或1958年那样在今天呈现。”

ex.s: Writing was so difficult and painful for me that my teacher had allowed me to present my paper on the sinking of the Titanic by acting out a play, where I played all the parts.
ex.t: 写作对我来说太困难、太痛苦，以至于老师允许我通过表演一出戏来呈现关于泰坦尼克号沉没的论文，在戏里我扮演了所有角色。

ex.s: Writing was so difficult and painful for me that my teacher had allowed me to present my paper on the sinking of the Titanic by acting out a play, where I played all the parts.
ex.t: 写作对我来说太困难、太痛苦，以至于老师允许我通过表演一出戏来呈现关于泰坦尼克号沉没的论文，在戏里我扮演了所有角色。

defs.def: to cause sth to happen or be experienced 使发生；使经历
to suddenly happen or become available 机会、答案等

ex.s: Tom is proud of his design and excited to be selling the Fun Bottle on his website and in stores but this 15-year-old is most proud of the opportunities that Fun Bottle presents to others.
ex.t: Tom对他的设计感到自豪，也很兴奋能在他的网站和商店销售Fun Bottle，但这位15岁少年最引以为豪的是Fun Bottle为他人带来的机会。

ex.s: Tom is most proud of the opportunities that Fun Bottle presents to others because he not only provides healthy alternatives to sugary drinks but also donates all the profits to the OHG.
ex.t: Tom最引以为豪Fun Bottle为他人的带来机会是因为他不仅提供了含糖饮料的健康替代品，还将所有利润捐赠给了OHG。

defs.def: to appear in a radio or television programme and introduce the different items in it 主持播放；主持（节目）

ex.s: And the Good Morning Britain presenter says she’s been able to put a lot of what she’s leant into practice in her own home, preparing meals for sons, Sam, 14, Finn, 13, and Jack, 11.
ex.t: 这位《早安英国》主持人说，她已能把学到的很多东西付诸自家实践，为14岁的萨姆、13岁的芬恩和11岁的杰克三个儿子做饭。

ex.s: Sherman Cymru is excited to present a packed programme of the very best theatre, dance, family shows and music from Wales and the rest of the world.
ex.t: Sherman Cymru很高兴呈献一套密集的节目，囊括来自威尔士及世界各地最优秀的戏剧、舞蹈、家庭秀和音乐。

ex.s: We begin on 1st June with Manchester Camerata and Nicola Benedetti, presenting an amazing programme of Mozart pieces.
ex.t: 我们于6月1日开幕，由曼彻斯特室内乐团和尼古拉·本内代蒂呈现一套精彩的莫扎特作品节目。

defs.def: to produce a show, play, broadcast, etc. for the public 上演；公演；推出

ex.s: The City of Burlington public art program is presenting a series of temporary public art signs at the Beachway in conjunction with the Ontario Culture Days.
ex.t: Burlington市公共艺术项目正与安大略文化节合作，在Beachway展出一系列临时公共艺术标识。

defs.def: to introduce sb formally, especially to sb of higher rank or status 正式介绍；引见

ex.s: What is presented in the final chapter of part one?
ex.t: 第一部分的最后一章介绍了什么内容？

defs.def: to officially appear somewhere 正式出席；莅临；出现

ex.s: This research overturns the popular view that all human speech sounds were present when human beings evolved around 300,000 years ago. ”The set of speech sounds we use has not necessarily remained stable since the appearance of human beings, but rather the huge variety of speech sounds that we find today is the product of a complex interplay of things like biological change and cultural evolution,“ said Steven Moran, a member of the research team.
ex.t: 这项研究推翻了“人类约30万年前进化时所有语音都已存在”的流行观点。“我们使用的语音集合自人类出现以来未必保持稳定，我们今天发现的极其多样的语音，是生物变化和文化演变等事物复杂相互作用的产物，”研究团队成员史蒂文·莫兰说。

defs.def: to offer or express sth in speech or writing （口头或书面）表达，表示
to give sb a cheque or bill that they should pay 交付；提交

ex.s: How past events should be presented.
ex.t: 过去的事件应该如何呈现。
